name: Parcel Hub
description:
Three arrival bursts feed scan and dispatch desks.

Can a short cover shift handle the dispatch peak?

Starting assumptions
• Exactly 150 parcels arrive in three ten-minute bursts across a two-hour shift.
• Dispatch has two physical stations but only one worker in the original plan.
• Parcels are processed individually; vehicles, conveyors and consolidated departure loads are not modeled.

Synthetic teaching models. Timings, demand and staffing are illustrative; layout does not add travel time.
